title: Integral data of an integer multiplicity representation
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (Z : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), R.Represents Z → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → R.measure K < ∞) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable R.orient R.measure ∧ ((∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |R.orient x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |R.orient x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Z ω = ∫ x, R.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂R.measure
